title: Fourier weight bound away from level one
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ and let $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ have cardinality different from $1$. For $T\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, write $\widehat f(T)=\mathbb E_x[f(x)\prod_{i\in T}x_i]$, where $x$ is uniform on the sign cube, and let $W_1(f)=\sum_{|T|=1}\widehat f(T)^2$. Then $W_1(f)+\widehat f(S)^2\le 1$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
$S$ is a subset of the coordinates
